mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 53 degrees out at Badger Prairie County Park with an air quality index of 62. You can also catch the International Space Station crossing the sky tomorrow morning at 5:47 AM, rising over Cross Plains and traveling toward Madison near Home Depot, staying low near the horizon for three minutes.

The City of Verona is moving forward with several development items, including the Ardent Glen third addition and site plans for Milky Way, which the Plan Commission will review on November 4th. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, with payment options available through the City Center or online via Access Dane.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers' Market returns to the Capitol Square, and Paddy Mac's will host live music in the evening.

Regarding public safety, the Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15th, a school bus driver was arrested for O W I while transporting students, with no injuries reported during the incident.
For dessert today, the flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is closed right now but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve up your favorites.
